column2: Besides, you seem to care about this world more than I thought.{wait}{clear}To be honest, I thought a world like this might mean nothing to you.{wait}{clear}But hearing you just now, I understand how you feel.{wait}{clear}I'm sorry for jumping to such rude conclusions.{wait}{clear}
No, Fein, please don't worry about it. I'm very happy we could talk like this, too.{wait}{clear}
Whoa, we've been talking a long time. Let's head out.{wait}{clear}
I enjoyed talking with you tonight...{wait}{clear}
Good night... ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Good night.{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄, would you keep me company for a while?{wait}{clear}
Yes, I don't mind. Is there something you want to talk about?{wait}{clear}
Yeah, something like that... Well, let's go.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry... There's something else I need to do.{wait}{clear}
I see... Then it can't be helped.{wait}{clear}Well, take care.{wait}{clear}
Is your work as an angel going well?{wait}{clear}
Yes. With the support of many heroes, I've been able to quell a great deal of turmoil.{wait}{clear}
I see. Good.{wait}{clear}
But from now on, more turmoil, and greater turmoil, will strike the world.{wait}{clear}When I think about that...{wait}{clear}
You're uneasy...{wait}{clear}
No... I can't say such a thing in front of the people who fight alongside me...{wait}{clear}
But I'm uneasy too...{wait}{clear}
And I'm sure your other heroes are as well.{wait}{clear}
No... For now, I'm barely managing to quell the turmoil...{wait}{clear}But the greater turmoil that's likely to come... honestly, as things stand...{wait}{clear}
You're uneasy...{wait}{clear}
I think it's very rude to the heroes for me, an angel, to say something like this...{wait}{clear}
No... I'm glad to hear how you honestly feel.{wait}{clear}
No one knows what lies ahead...{wait}{clear}
For now, all we can do is what we can.{wait}{clear}
Let's believe that, in time, it will lead to the future...{wait}{clear}
Yes...{wait}{clear}Um... may I ask you something, Fein? Why do you help me?{wait}{clear}
Because you saved my life...{n}
That's not the only reason...{wait}{clear}
